snippet.title: The Birdwatcher's Journal Trailer
snippet.description:
INTRODUCING: The Birdwatcher's Journal🐦

Photograph and identify birds on a mysterious island. Each bird you discover brings you one step closer to uncovering what happened to the researcher before you, and the secrets of the island.

We're working on a new game, and excited to share it with everyone! Stay tuned for more updates, and wishlist it on Steam!

🏝️Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4897410/Birdwatcher/?utm_source=socials&utm_medium=youtube&utm_campaign=post&utm_id=internal&utm_content=page_launch

----

Join our Discord community or follow our socials for updates, resources and events!
